mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_bookmark ( course_id, user_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS title, c.description AS description, , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_place cp WHERE cp.course_id = c.course_id) AS placeCount, cb.created_at AS bookmarkedAt FROM course_bookmark cb JOIN course c ON c.course_id = cb.course_id WHERE cb.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY cb.created_at DESC, cb.course_bookmark_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_bookmark cb JOIN course c ON c.course_id = cb.course_id WHERE cb.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
